topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
consensus_response: To optimize satellite link budgets for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage, a balanced approach is necessary that considers multiple aspects: antenna array design, advanced path selection algorithms, bandwidth allocation, link budget optimization, and interference mitigation. A hybrid array configuration with both closely and widely spaced elements can be employed to dynamically adjust the trade-off between gain and interference based on real-time link conditions. This approach complements the dynamic resource allocation algorithm, which optimizes throughput and latency for global aeronautical coverage, taking into account real-time link conditions, QoS requirements, and link characteristics. Standardizing link information acquisition for path calculations will further enhance the accuracy of resource allocation, leading to optimized performance for global aeronautical coverage.

The interplay between array factor and spacing effects necessitates a trade-off between link gain and interference mitigation, impacting the overall performance and capacity of the satellite network.
